pages.title: Ordinal Shard
pages.text: A piece of the order in which infinities come: first, second, third and onward past omega. Ordinals count positions, not sizes. The shard has sharp, clearly ordered facets, each following the last. No two are ever equal.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hilbert Bellhops and Ordinal Hounds dropped these, and I found more in Hilbert's Hotel and the Ordinal Spire. Later I cut them from ordinal stone with the Planck-Scale Cutter.
